items.title: Phoebe Jacobs and Jackie Harris interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 21, 2006
items.q: this writer, this columnist who was involved with the Boys Town of Italy gave Ella’s show a write-up of four columns, twelve paragraphs, about Ray Bryant, who was the piano player that opened for Ella

ctx.x: Do you think Louis Armstrong had a sense of how loved he was?

No, no. Not at all. In fact it was my habit in working in a club, and I told you some of the people we had, Duke, Ella, Sarah, Basie, Oscar Peterson, Louis. After opening I would read the papers and I’d go in the dressing room and I’d read them something or I’d leave it in the dressing room. I said to Pops, “Did you see the review?” He said, “I don’t read that stuff.” I said, “Louis, aren’t you — I don’t believe you, it was just so exciting,” whatever. He said, “Look, I’m not interested. When a trumpet player…
That’s great. When you get home, what’s on your CD player?
